model.architecture: 26.4B MoE, 3.4B active (5.4B effective; looped transformer, middle 12 layers run 3x), multimodal (text+image), 1M context

frozen_at: 2026-11-21 (this commit; before any Inkling request to the Studio)

reasoning.why: Every frozen Studio engine requested reasoning_effort high with max_tokens 4096 (the default-thinking protocol). Inkling's template accepts none|minimal|low|medium|high|xhigh|max or a float in [0, 0.99] (unknown strings raise, no silent fallback) and defaults to 0.9 == high, so high is both the frozen request and the model's own default. Reasoning counts against max_tokens 4096 (length abstention if exhausted).
reasoning.gate: binding before the pilot (ink.ts probegate): the probe loads the pinned file on the Studio; on both synthetic inputs native-v0 high and no-effort requests return 200 with a JSON concernScore answer and identical prompt_tokens, reasoning hash and content hash. Not binding, reported: effort forwarding (none = 2 prompt tokens fewer; low/medium/xhigh reasoning differs), unknown-value behaviour, /v1, speculative decoding / MTP state (load-config keys, draft-token counts). A PROBE_FAIL skips the variant (no pilot, no full run).

q8.label: inkling2mini-q8gguf
q8.role: primary (protocol-matched: Q8_0 GGUF, llama.cpp runtime, like every prior Studio model)

hf.note: LM Studio sizeBytes 28461905056 = Q8_0 27820099168 + mmproj BF16 641805888; embedded chat template sha256 53a9035f... == upstream thinkingmachines chat_template.jinja (results/template-audit.json)

q8.effortMechanism: lmstudio native-v0 request reasoning_effort high (as every frozen Studio engine); the embedded template (== upstream, sha256 53a9035f) maps high and an absent effort both to 'Thinking effort level: 0.9', so the rendering is 0.9 whether or not LM Studio forwards the field; verified by the pre-run probe (PROBE line)
q8.speculativeDecoding: LM Studio default, not set by the driver (as every frozen Studio engine); recorded by the pre-run probe (load config) and per response from usage draft-token counts (#52)

mlx4.label: inkling2mini-mlx4bit
mlx4.role: secondary (different runtime: MLX, and different quantization: 4-bit; not protocol-matched)
mlx4.effortMechanism: lmstudio native-v0 request reasoning_effort high (as every frozen Studio engine); the bundled chat_template.jinja of every mlx-community candidate equals upstream (sha256 53a9035f), high == absent == 'Thinking effort level: 0.9'; verified by the pre-run probe (PROBE line) on the MLX runtime
mlx4.speculativeDecoding: LM Studio default, not set by the driver (as every frozen Studio engine); recorded by the pre-run probe (load config) and per response from usage draft-token counts (#52)

autoPin.rule: used only while plan.json has no mlx4 pin: exactly one Studio inventory entry with format safetensors whose modelKey or indexed identifier contains 'inkling-2-mini', identical on two probes 2 min apart; the chain records the pin and the HF repo file list (sizes, LFS sha256, revision) at that time in <run dir>/pins/mlx4.auto*.json, writes the three suites with ink.ts, and logs a PIN line. Zero matches = defer; several = SKIP (never guessed). The repo/quant identified this way is recorded in the report.

pilot.note: first N cases of each cohort in dataset order (--max-new-segments); bipia-email-mixed 24 = the drift reference

gates.drift: first 24 bipia-email-mixed cases of the run condition: finished 24/24, prompt_tokens == the pilot's on the same cases 24/24, identity (response model, model_info.quant, loaded file) 24/24; outcome agreement and identical answers reported
gates.pilot: binding before the full run (ink.ts pilotgate): all 50 planned pilot cases finished; identity (response model, model_info.quant, loaded file) and usage on every response; abstentions (length + output) <= 25%; a full-run estimate computable. A PILOT_FAIL skips the variant. Parse rate, abstentions, wall time and the estimate are reported in the PILOT line.
